agent_note: Multi-voiced book. Two distinct strands visible in the quotes: (a) a collective 'we' strand of past-tense historical exposition about Native/Urban Indian history (q02794, q02798, q02805, q02808, q02810, q02815) and first-person retrospection (q02813, q02824), and (b) present-tense character sections in third and second person (q02828, q02823, q02803, q02829). Not diary/epistolary — dual here means strand split, not writing-moment vs. recounting. Very high gnomic share (19/43): the quote source is dominated by essayistic/aphoristic prologue-style material, so gnomic was applied only to present-tense generalization beyond the story world; all past-tense exposition and summary was filed event/past per METHODOLOGY.md. Several dialogue quotes lost their quotation marks in the Goodreads text; those were identified by vocative and speech-marker evidence, recorded per quote. Flip-risk: q02814.
